query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.userType = 'university_student' AND (u.name IS NULL OR u.name LIKE 'User %' OR u.name LIKE '사용자 %' OR u.name = '') ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 20;
